name: O Loan blood cockle
summary: Blood cockles from Đầm Ô Loan, with thick pink meat and yellow roe. Grilled on charcoal until the juices run, they are eaten hot with salt, pepper, and lime.
origin: Phu Yen. Đầm Ô Loan, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s cockle note of 29 December 2020, its lagoon article, and its 6 October 2024 cẩm nang.
texture: Thick pink meat with yellow roe.
taste: Stir-fried with salt and chilli as rang muối ớt, the cockles are lightly hot, fragrant, and sweet. The grilled plate needs only salt, pepper, and lime.
howToEat: Grill the scrubbed shells over charcoal until the juices run, open them by hand, and add salt, pepper, and lime. Eat them hot with a spoon, on shore or on a night boat on the lagoon.
They also come nướng tái, xào me, hấp, gỏi, or rang muối ớt.
where: Đầm Ô Loan, 25 km north of the city, and the floating kitchens at cầu An Hải.
seoTitle: O Loan cockles — grilled until the liquor runs
seoDescription: Pink cockles with yellow roe from Dam O Loan, grilled on charcoal with salt, pepper, and lime, 25 km north of Tuy Hoa.
culture: Tổ chức Kỷ lục Việt Nam lists the Ô Loan cockle in a Top 10 of Vietnamese seafood. The shells were once used by the Quảng Đức pottery.
